'''Curt Meyer''' (19 November 1919 – 18 April 2011) was a German [[mathematician]]. He made notable contributions to [[number theory]].

A native of [[Bremerhaven]], Meyer obtained his [[doctorate]] from the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]] in 1950, under supervision of [[Helmut Hasse]]. In 1966 he became professor of mathematics at the [[University of Cologne]], a position he held until 1985.

Among his most important results is an alternative solution to the [[class number 1 problem]], building on the original [[Stark–Heegner theorem]].<ref>{{cite journal |last=Meyer |first=Curt |author-mask=3 |year=1970 |title=Bemerkungen zum Satz von Heegner-Stark über die imaginär-quadratischen Zahlkörper mit der Klassenzahl Eins |journal=[[Crelle's Journal|Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik]] |volume=1970 |issue=242 |pages=179–214 |doi=10.1515/crll.1970.242.179 |s2cid=118890772 }}</ref>
